Text-Table Cells from a Per-Unit Table

Source: R/figure-data-tests.R
PlotDataTableCells.Rd

Transposes a table with one row per unit (patient, analysis) into the cells of a small text table for PlotTextBlock(): a header row with the unit labels and one row per value column, each with a row label in the first column. Values are written as numbers (whole numbers without decimals, missing as "NE"), as text for text columns, or from one template per table row (see FormatTemplate()). Cells whose value lies below highlight_below are flagged.

Usage

PlotDataTableCells(
  data,
  id,
  values = NULL,
  row_labels = values,
  header = "",
  key = NULL,
  highlight_below = NULL,
  zero_text = NULL,
  templates = NULL
)

Arguments

data

A data frame, one row per unit, in display order.

id

Column with the unit labels shown in the header.

values

Value columns, one table row each (optional with templates).

row_labels

Labels of the value rows.

header

Label of the header row.

key

Optional column copied to the header cells as key (for example a group used to colour header text).

highlight_below

Values below this are flagged (highlight = TRUE).

zero_text

Optional text written instead of zero values.

templates

Optional templates, one per table row, filled from each unit's row (for example "p = {p|p}").

Value

A data frame of cells with row, column, label, header, highlight and key.

Examples

d <- data.frame(id = c("1", "2"), a = c(3, 0), b = c(12, 40), g = c("x", "y"))
PlotDataTableCells(d, "id", c("a", "b"), c("First", "Second"), key = "g",
                   highlight_below = 10, zero_text = "0 (NE)")
#>   row column  label header highlight  key
#> 1   1      1          TRUE     FALSE <NA>
#> 2   1      2      1   TRUE     FALSE    x
#> 3   1      3      2   TRUE     FALSE    y
#> 4   2      1  First  FALSE     FALSE <NA>
#> 5   2      2      3  FALSE      TRUE <NA>
#> 6   2      3 0 (NE)  FALSE      TRUE <NA>
#> 7   3      1 Second  FALSE     FALSE <NA>
#> 8   3      2     12  FALSE     FALSE <NA>
#> 9   3      3     40  FALSE     FALSE <NA>
PlotDataTableCells(data.frame(id = c("A", "B"), p = c(0.018, 0.058)), "id",
                   row_labels = "Permutation test", templates = "p = {p|p}")
#>   row column            label header highlight key
#> 1   1      1                    TRUE     FALSE  NA
#> 2   1      2                A   TRUE     FALSE  NA
#> 3   1      3                B   TRUE     FALSE  NA
#> 4   2      1 Permutation test  FALSE     FALSE  NA
#> 5   2      2        p = 0.018  FALSE     FALSE  NA
#> 6   2      3        p = 0.058  FALSE     FALSE  NA
